resources.string: Use English or Roman Hindi/Hinglish, up to 4,000 characters. Devanagari is not supported in this version.

Only text you ask to translate is sent through our translation server to Google\'s Gemini API. Under Google\'s free tier, content may be reviewed by people and used to improve its products. Please don\'t translate sensitive or confidential text. We don\'t save translation text or results. Our server stores total request counts to limit usage. No account or sign-in is needed.
No internet connection. Connect and try again.
Translation is busy right now. Try again in a moment.
That took too long. Try again.
Couldn\'t reach the translation service. Try again.
Got an unexpected response. Try again.
Translate inside your keyboard, without display-over-apps permission. Write English ↔ Roman Hindi/Hinglish, or read a message in English above the keys.

Enable and choose Lingo keyboard, then open a chat input. Tap Translate to open a private draft, choose the direction and tap Translate & insert. Read loads copied text for confirmation and shows the English result above the keys. Normal typing stays on your phone. Symbols, Shift/Caps Lock and 50 emoji are included; predictions and swipe typing are not yet included.

Keyboard translation needs no reading session. Selected text from the active editor is available through Translate selection. For received messages outside an editor, use copy + Read. Lingo-Translate also remains available in compatible selection menus.
Lingo keyboard selected: open a chat input to translate above the keys. No overlay permission required.
Choose Lingo keyboard for translation above the keys. The optional floating mode can still work with another keyboard.
Floating translations could not start. Allow display over other apps and try again. This phone or app may restrict overlays.
Allow LingoTranslate to display over other apps so the English result can float over your current app.
Reading session started. Return to your chat or game.
Floating translation is active. Tap Stop to end the session.
Open reading translation or translate copied text. Drag to move.
Message copied. Translate it to English?
No readable English or Roman Hindi message found. Copy a text message and try again. Passwords, sensitive clips and unsupported text are skipped.
Open translation, or translate selected editor text into English
Read selected or copied text in English above the keyboard
Paste a received message to read in English…
Shift on for one letter. Double tap for Caps Lock
This app did not share selected editor text. Copy the message and use Read instead.
Translation inserted. Review it before sending.
The chat cursor changed or insertion was unavailable. Review the result and tap Insert here, or copy it.
Open the chat input with Lingo keyboard to see this message in English. Available for 60 seconds.
